name: Path to Ascension: Prestige tells the client its tutorial state and refused starts get an answer (#6079)
contract: Tutorial 56 (Tutorial.dbc: achievement 87246, quest 1903520 'Path to Ascension: Rank Up Your Spells', level 8) is a tracking quest view: the book's Start Quest button sends CMSG_QUESTGIVER_ACCEPT_QUEST (393) with an empty quest giver, which puts 1903520 in the log and sets core.ascension.tutorial_tracking[56].

Prestige (quest 580183: 'Your quest log will be wiped') abandons 1903520 but keeps the Path to Ascension claims. The client only learns the claimed list from SMSG_TUTORIAL_REWARDED_LIST (0x6B0, 1712), which was sent at login alone, so after Prestige it kept offering a tutorial the server refused.
After Prestige the server must resend 0x6B0 and clear the tracking marker whose quest is no longer in the log.

A Start Quest the server refuses must be answered on SMSG_CLAIM_TUTORIAL_REWARD_RESULT (0x6AF, 1711), the C string PathToAscension.lua shows in UIErrorsFrame: below level 8 the tutorial is not available, and a claimed tutorial reports its reward as already collected. Neither refusal adds the quest.
The client's Objectives pane is not observable here; it remains an in-game check.
